name: llm-upstream-monitor
description: Local-first NewAPI / Sub2API balance monitor with Web UI and Windows portable desktop app
author: Kazi6de1b

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @llm-upstream-monitor/api" "npm run dev -w @llm-upstream-monitor/web"
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/shared && npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/api && concurrently -n web,desktop -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @llm-upstream-monitor/web" "wait-on http://localhost:5300 && npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/desktop && electron apps/desktop/dist/main.js --web-url=http://localhost:5300"
scripts.desktop:build: npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/shared && npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/api && npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/web && npm run build -w @llm-upstream-monitor/desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json
